pages.name: Remote Desktop
pages.promotionalText: See and control your Mac from iPhone or iPad through built-in Screen Sharing and Remote Login. Use pointer controls, Compose Text and SFTP files. No Mac helper.

pages.name: SSH Terminal
pages.promotionalText: Open your Mac’s SSH Terminal on iPhone or iPad. Use a password or Ed25519 key, scrollback, Compose Text, and familiar controls. Built-in Remote Login; no helper.

pages.name: Trackpad & Keyboard
pages.promotionalText: Turn iPhone or iPad into a trackpad and keyboard for a Mac you can see. Tap, drag, scroll, and Compose Text. Uses Screen Sharing over SSH; no Mac helper.

creativeAssets.strategy: Light v10 palette, official iPhone and iPad bezels; same unaltered synthetic current-source captures. Header pairs iPad and iPhone; Search uses iPhone. All binaries and artboards remain outside application Git.
creativeAssets.format: 8-bit RGB PNG with sRGB ICC profile, no alpha; universal 16:9 placement
